title: Endurance

slides.title: THEY LIVED ON FLOATING ICE FOR 5 MONTHS

slides.text: The ice crushed their ship. 28 men were left camping on the frozen Weddell Sea, far from any help.
The ice they slept on was drifting, and slowly breaking apart. Cracks could open anywhere, even under a tent.
Their food ran low. They hunted seals and penguins to stay alive.
It was far below freezing. Their clothes were wool and fur. Nothing was waterproof.
April 1916. The ice finally breaks up. They push the 3 lifeboats into the freezing sea and row for a week.
They reach Elephant Island. Solid ground for the first time in 497 days.

But no ships ever came to Elephant Island. Nobody knew they were alive.
Part 3: the most dangerous boat trip ever attempted.

caption: Five months living on drifting ice, then a week in open lifeboats. They finally touched land, and it was the loneliest island on Earth. Endurance, part 2 of 4.
